decisions: MIS-PORT, not unported and not a deliberate simplification: check_input_trial_use passes the trial's CALLEE-relative address to FuncProto::get_local_range().in_range(), where upstream fspec.cc:5618 passes the argument Varnode's CALLER-relative address. Everything else on the path (create_placeholder, resolve_spacebase_relative, guard_calls IPTR_SPACEBASE translation, build_input_from_trials) is line-for-line faithful and verified working by instrumentation.

The published triage hypothesis (guard_calls short-circuits via tryregister=false because stackoffset stays OFFSET_UNKNOWN) is FALSE. Instrumented on both x86-64 and i386: tryregister=true, stackoffset resolves, register_trial + op_insert_input both run. The trials exist and are then scored no-use.

kuna's own spec chapter already documents the correct behaviour ('outside the caller's local stack range'), and the port comment in the code documents the incorrect one ('the callee's local range') - the implementation contradicts its own normative chapter.
The fix is one argument. Verified on a scratch build behind an env gate: witness, ssh-add/parse_dest_constraint and mydoom/msg_b64enc all fully recovered.

Ablation measured on the scratch build: kuna test --datatests -> 675/675 PARITY OK (zero assertions move). Stage corpus 304/305: the single movement is gh6882-sparcstructret #2, which is ITSELF a correctness improvement (the SPARC hidden struct-return buffer pointer is now passed: f() -> f(v2)); only the pinned expression text needs updating.
Speed: no detectable delta (ssh-add decompile-all 10.80s -> 10.79s median of 3; mydoom 2.03s -> 1.98s min of 3).

Recommend shipping GATED (option callsitestackargs, tier core, change_kind correctness-fix) despite being a strict bug fix, because it changes emitted C at a large fraction of call sites in every stripped binary on every architecture and has a known artifact class (over-recovery on unprototyped __cdecl callees). Default-ON is earned by the ablation. No DIV row needed - this converges on upstream rather than diverging from it - but docs/history.md should record the mis-port and its correction.

Known artifact accepted for now: on i386, stale outgoing-argument slots from a previous call can be accepted as arguments of a later unprototyped call (mydoom CloseHandle renders with 5 arguments where it takes 1). Upstream Ghidra shares this behaviour and escapes it via PE IAT import prototypes; that is sequenced as increment 2.

Alternative B (suppress only the dataflow-freeing for spacebase trials, fixing the dead-code-elimination symptom without recovering arguments) was considered and rejected: it is MORE code than the real fix, produces strictly worse output, and increases divergence from upstream. There is no useful smaller first increment.

CORRECTION to docs/decbench/triage/O0-mydoom-mydoom-msg_b64enc.md: its claim that a full DWARF prototype does not help ('the locked path drops it too') is NOT reproducible on this build. Both witnesses compiled -g decompile correctly WITHOUT the fix and are byte-identical WITH it; the same sources stripped reproduce the bug.

REFINEMENT to the blast-radius claim in the parent task and both triage docs: the defect bites every call site whose callee prototype is UNLOCKED - that is all of them in a stripped binary, and measurably about half of them even with full DWARF (calls_ge7_args 37->73 on the six DWARF binaries), because DWARF locks only the prototypes it describes. 'Where DWARF is present, stack arguments are already recovered' is true of the short-call metrics (they move by exactly zero) but false of the >=7-argument count.

dwarf_split_n6.verdict: HALF-supports 'DWARF already fixes it'. Short-call metrics move by exactly zero with DWARF present (68->68, 81->81) vs -28/-74 stripped. But calls_ge7_args still nearly doubles with DWARF (37->73), because DWARF locks only the prototypes it describes - internal statics, tail-called helpers and undocumented imports stay unlocked. Both endpoints converge on the identical 73 with or without debug info.

sweep.kstackfix_only_failures: NONE. All 72 runs exited 0; stderr byte-identical between stock and fixed on every pair. Five binaries re-run with full stderr + dump-level counters (function count, empty-body count, error markers): all deltas zero. Pre-existing panics (ruleaction_2.rs:96 CPUI_INT_SRIGHT, heritage.rs:2775, address.rs:180) appear identically on both sides.
caveats: short_calls ROSE on bzip2 O2 (12->18) and bzip2 O2-noinline (36->40): the metric is self-referential, so lengthening a callee's own recovered prototype can make previously-complete call sites short. Net is still -803.
empty_short is unchanged for EVERY x86-64 and ARM binary (414->414, 203->203). The empty-argument-list win is exclusively an i386 phenomenon, as SysV's 6 register arguments predicts.
freertos/RTOSDemo.out is degenerate at all three opt levels (0-1 direct calls found) due to an ARM Cortex-M function-discovery limitation; the ARM column effectively rests on chibios/ch.elf alone.
Stock calls_ge7_args is 0 on 25/30 binaries, not all: the 7 corpus-wide stock sites come from the LOCKED-prototype path (libproto/DWARF), which never reaches the broken predicate.
